title: Pages Ari makes
description: What a page Ari made holds. A rich, lasting answer, such as a gallery guide, a menu pick or a comparison, comes back as a short reply with an `ari:made` card that opens the page. Pages are living (Ari keeps them current, and says what changed), interactive (sections fold, things tick off) and shareable. Ari writes the content; apps read it, and tick its items as `MadeState` in the events schema describes.

MadeContent.description: The page under its title: an opening, then its sections in order.

intro.description: A few sentences under the title, in Markdown. It may hold `ari:` blocks, such as a place.

check.description: The word for ticking an item off, such as `Spotted`: its items are then things to tick ("Spotted it?", "Spotted at 14:32", "3 of 9 spotted"). Absent when nothing on the page ticks.

MadeSection.description: One part of the page, such as a room in a gallery. A numbered section folds, and opens with its picture, words and items; an unnumbered one is a small heading over what it holds, always open, such as "Halfway" over a café.

detail.description: One line under the title, such as "Room 46a–b · 25 min".

badge.description: A word or two Ari wants seen, such as "Back in" after a change.

numbered.description: False for a small heading. Numbered when absent.

text.description: Markdown, which may hold `ari:` blocks, such as a place with Directions.

MadeItem.description: One thing in a section, such as something to spot. It ticks off when the page has a `check` word.

detail.description: A line or two on it, such as where to look.
